description.value:
Earth Dragon Bullet. A dragon's head of compressed earth surges from the ground and barrels along a 60-foot line, 5 feet wide. Creatures take 7d8 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex save; failure imposes off-guard against your next melee Strike.

The dragon leaves a 5-foot-wide trench of difficult terrain along its path for 10 minutes. A common Suiton-Doton combo follows this jutsu with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.spells.Item.SpllSwSuiryuudan]{Suiryuudan} to coat the dragon in mud, dealing an additional 2d6 cold damage.

Heightened (+1) Damage increases by 1d8.
